items.name: utils
items.title: DOM Target Utilities
items.description: Utilities (resolveTargetElement, isRefObject) for resolving DOM elements and React refs.

items.name: useAnimationFrame
items.title: useAnimationFrame
items.description: Runs a callback on every `requestAnimationFrame` tick with delta time tracking, FPS limiting, and playback controls.

items.name: useAsyncTask
items.title: useAsyncTask
items.description: Manages the manual execution, cancellation, and state of an asynchronous task with `AbortSignal` support.

items.name: useBeforeUnload
items.title: useBeforeUnload
items.description: Prompts the user with a confirmation dialog before leaving or reloading the page.

items.name: useBoolean
items.title: useBoolean
items.description: Manages a boolean state with helper functions to set, reset, and toggle the value.

items.name: useBroadcastChannel
items.title: useBroadcastChannel
items.description: Communicates between browser tabs, windows, or iframes of the same origin using the `BroadcastChannel` API.

items.name: useControllableState
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: Manages state that can be either controlled externally or uncontrolled with an internal fallback.

items.name: useCookie
items.title: useCookie
items.description: Reads, writes, and deletes a browser cookie reactively using `useSyncExternalStore`.

items.name: useCopyToClipboard
items.title: useCopyToClipboard
items.description: Copies text to the system clipboard and tracks the copied state with an optional auto-reset timer.

items.name: useCountdown
items.title: useCountdown
items.description: Manages a configurable countdown (or count-up) timer with start, pause, and reset controls.

items.name: useCounter
items.title: useCounter
items.description: Manages a numeric counter state with optional min/max clamping and helper methods.

items.name: useDarkMode
items.title: useDarkMode
items.description: Manages dark mode state with system preference detection, `localStorage` persistence, and automatic DOM class toggling.

items.name: useDebounceCallback
items.title: useDebounceCallback
items.description: Creates a debounced version of a callback function with `leading`, `trailing`, `maxWait`, `cancel`, and `flush` support.

items.name: useDebounceValue
items.title: useDebounceValue
items.description: Debounces a reactive value and provides a debounced setter with `.cancel()`, `.flush()`, and `.isPending()` controls.

items.name: useDevicePixelRatio
items.title: useDevicePixelRatio
items.description: Tracks the current `window.devicePixelRatio` reactively across screen changes and browser zoom levels.

items.name: useDocumentTitle
items.title: useDocumentTitle
items.description: Updates `document.title` reactively and optionally restores the original title on unmount.

items.name: useDocumentVisibility
items.title: useDocumentVisibility
items.description: Tracks the current `document.visibilityState` (`'visible'` or `'hidden'`) using `useSyncExternalStore`.

items.name: useDropZone
items.title: useDropZone
items.description: Handles file drag-and-drop interactions with MIME/extension filtering via a target ref or `getRootProps`.

items.name: useElementRef
items.title: useElementRef
items.description: Provides a callback ref and reactive state for the mounted DOM element so effects re-run when the node attaches or detaches.

items.name: useElementScroll
items.title: useElementScroll
items.description: Tracks a scrollable element's scroll position, active scrolling state, movement directions, and edge arrival flags.

items.name: useElementSize
items.title: useElementSize
items.description: Tracks the width and height of a DOM element reactively using `ResizeObserver`.

items.name: useEventCallback
items.title: useEventCallback
items.description: Returns a referentially stable callback that always invokes the latest version of `fn`.

items.name: useEventListener
items.title: useEventListener
items.description: Attaches a type-safe event listener to `Window`, `Document`, `HTMLElement`, `SVGElement`, `MediaQueryList`, or custom `EventTarget` with automatic cleanup.

items.name: useFileDialog
items.title: useFileDialog
items.description: Opens the native file selection dialog programmatically without rendering a visible `<input type="file">` element.

items.name: useFirstMountState
items.title: useFirstMountState
items.description: Returns `true` during the initial render of a component and `false` on all subsequent renders.

items.name: useFocus
items.title: useFocus
items.description: Tracks and controls the focus state of a target DOM element, with optional `:focus-visible` filtering.

items.name: useFocusTrap
items.title: useFocusTrap
items.description: Traps keyboard `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` focus within a container element and optionally restores focus on unmount.

items.name: useFullscreen
items.title: useFullscreen
items.description: Manages fullscreen state for a target DOM element (or `document.documentElement`) with vendor prefix support.

items.name: useGeolocation
items.title: useGeolocation
items.description: Watches the user's geographic location reactively using `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition`.

items.name: useHash
items.title: useHash
items.description: Reads and updates `window.location.hash` reactively using `useSyncExternalStore`.

items.name: useHistoryState
items.title: useHistoryState
items.description: Manages state with undo/redo history tracking and configurable history capacity.

items.name: useHotkeys
items.title: useHotkeys
items.description: Listens for keyboard shortcut combinations (including cross-platform `mod` support) and invokes a callback when matched.

items.name: useHover
items.title: useHover
items.description: Tracks whether the pointer is hovering over a target DOM element, with optional enter and leave delays.

items.name: useHydrated
items.title: useHydrated
items.description: Returns `false` during server-side rendering and initial hydration, and `true` once hydrated on the client.

items.name: useIdle
items.title: useIdle
items.description: Tracks whether the user has been inactive for a given duration by listening to window interaction events.

items.name: useInert
items.title: useInert
items.description: Manages the `inert` and `aria-hidden` attributes on a target element (or its document-level siblings) with reference counting.

items.name: useInfiniteScroll
items.title: useInfiniteScroll
items.description: Triggers an asynchronous `onLoadMore` callback when a sentinel element scrolls into view using `IntersectionObserver`.

items.name: useIntersectionObserver
items.title: useIntersectionObserver
items.description: Observes changes in the intersection of a target DOM element with an ancestor element or the viewport.

items.name: useInterval
items.title: useInterval
items.description: Runs a callback repeatedly at a specified millisecond interval, pausing when `delay` is `null`.

items.name: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
items.title: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
items.description: Uses `useLayoutEffect` in browser environments and falls back to `useEffect` during server-side rendering to avoid React SSR warnings.

items.name: useKeyPress
items.title: useKeyPress
items.description: Tracks whether a specific key, hotkey combination, or custom key predicate is currently held down.

items.name: useLatest
items.title: useLatest
items.description: Returns a ref object whose `.current` property is synchronously updated to the latest value after every render.

items.name: useList
items.title: useList
items.description: Manages an array state with immutable helper methods for pushing, inserting, updating, removing, filtering, and sorting items.

items.name: useLocalStorage
items.title: useLocalStorage
items.description: Persists and synchronizes state with `window.localStorage` across components and browser tabs.

items.name: useLockBodyScroll
items.title: useLockBodyScroll
items.description: Locks scrolling on `document.body` (or a target element) with scrollbar gap compensation and reference counting across multiple active locks.

items.name: useLongPress
items.title: useLongPress
items.description: Detects long-press pointer gestures with movement threshold cancellation and click suppression.

items.name: useMap
items.title: useMap
items.description: Manages a reactive `Map` state with immutable helper actions for setting, deleting, clearing, and querying entries.

items.name: useMeasure
items.title: useMeasure
items.description: Measures the dimensions and box insets of a DOM element via a callback ref and `ResizeObserver`.

items.name: useMediaQuery
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Evaluates a CSS media query string and subscribes to changes reactively using `useSyncExternalStore`.

items.name: useMergeRefs
items.title: useMergeRefs
items.description: Combines multiple React refs (callback refs, `RefObject`s, or `null`/`undefined`) into a single stable callback ref with React 19 cleanup support.

items.name: useMouse
items.title: useMouse
items.description: Tracks mouse cursor coordinates across the document, viewport, screen, and an optional target element using `requestAnimationFrame`.

items.name: useMutationObserver
items.title: useMutationObserver
items.description: Observes DOM tree, attribute, or character data mutations on a target node using `MutationObserver`.

items.name: useNetworkInformation
items.title: useNetworkInformation
items.description: Tracks network connectivity status and connection quality metrics (`effectiveType`, `downlink`, `rtt`, `saveData`) via the Network Information API.

items.name: useObjectUrl
items.title: useObjectUrl
items.description: Creates a temporary object URL (`URL.createObjectURL`) for a `Blob`, `File`, or `MediaSource` and automatically revokes it on change or unmount.

items.name: useOnClickOutside
items.title: useOnClickOutside
items.description: Invokes a handler when a pointer, mouse, or touch interaction occurs outside one or more target elements (with Shadow DOM `composedPath` support).

items.name: useOnline
items.title: useOnline
items.description: Tracks whether the browser is currently connected to the network (`navigator.onLine`) using `useSyncExternalStore`.

items.name: usePagination
items.title: usePagination
items.description: Computes pagination state, page ranges with ellipsis markers, data slice indices, and navigation helpers.

items.name: usePermission
items.title: usePermission
items.description: Queries and subscribes to browser permission status changes via `navigator.permissions.query`.

items.name: usePointerDrag
items.title: usePointerDrag
items.description: Tracks pointer drag gestures on a target element with axis locking and movement thresholds.

items.name: usePreferredLanguage
items.title: usePreferredLanguage
items.description: Tracks the user's preferred browser language (`navigator.language`) and updates on changes.

items.name: usePrevious
items.title: usePrevious
items.description: Returns the value passed on the previous render.

items.name: usePreviousDistinct
items.title: usePreviousDistinct
items.description: Returns the most recent distinct value prior to the current value.

items.name: useQueue
items.title: useQueue
items.description: Manages a reactive FIFO (first-in, first-out) queue in React state.

items.name: useRafCallback
items.title: useRafCallback
items.description: Throttles a callback so it executes at most once per `requestAnimationFrame` with the latest arguments.

items.name: useResizeObserver
items.title: useResizeObserver
items.description: Observes size changes on a target DOM element using the `ResizeObserver` API.

items.name: useRovingTabIndex
items.title: useRovingTabIndex
items.description: Implements the WAI-ARIA roving `tabIndex` keyboard navigation pattern for composite widgets.

items.name: useScreenOrientation
items.title: useScreenOrientation
items.description: Tracks the device screen orientation and provides `lock` and `unlock` controls.

items.name: useScript
items.title: useScript
items.description: Dynamically loads an external `<script>` tag, deduplicating across components and tracking its status.

items.name: useScrollSpy
items.title: useScrollSpy
items.description: Observes a list of page sections and returns the `id` of the currently active section in view.

items.name: useSelection
items.title: useSelection
items.description: Manages single or multi-item selection state with range selection and bulk toggle helpers.

items.name: useSessionStorage
items.title: useSessionStorage
items.description: Persists reactive state in `window.sessionStorage` with automatic serialization and synchronization.

items.name: useSet
items.title: useSet
items.description: Manages a reactive `Set` in React state with immutable update helpers.

items.name: useSpinDelay
items.title: useSpinDelay
items.description: Prevents loading indicator flashes by delaying appearance and enforcing a minimum display duration.

items.name: useSwipe
items.title: useSwipe
items.description: Detects pointer swipe gestures and directions on a target element.

items.name: useTextareaAutosize
items.title: useTextareaAutosize
items.description: Automatically adjusts the height of a `<textarea>` element to fit its content.

items.name: useTextSelection
items.title: useTextSelection
items.description: Tracks the user's current text selection, bounding rectangle, and ranges within the document or a target container.

items.name: useThrottleCallback
items.title: useThrottleCallback
items.description: Creates a throttled version of a callback that executes at most once every `wait` milliseconds.

items.name: useThrottleValue
items.title: useThrottleValue
items.description: Throttles state updates to a value so it changes at most once per `wait` milliseconds.

items.name: useTimeout
items.title: useTimeout
items.description: Declarative `setTimeout` hook that invokes a callback after `delay` milliseconds.

items.name: useToggle
items.title: useToggle
items.description: Manages a boolean state with a `toggle` function that also accepts an explicit boolean or DOM event.

items.name: useUnmount
items.title: useUnmount
items.description: Executes a cleanup callback when the component unmounts, always using the latest function reference.

items.name: useUnmountedRef
items.title: useUnmountedRef
items.description: Returns a read-only ref whose `current` value is `true` after the component has unmounted.

items.name: useUpdateEffect
items.title: useUpdateEffect
items.description: Runs a `useEffect` callback only on dependency updates, skipping the initial mount.

items.name: useUrlSearchParams
items.title: useUrlSearchParams
items.description: Reads and updates `window.location.search` as reactive `URLSearchParams` synchronized with browser history.

items.name: useVirtualList
items.title: useVirtualList
items.description: Virtualizes a large list of fixed or variable-height items so only visible rows are rendered.

items.name: useVisualViewport
items.title: useVisualViewport
items.description: Tracks the browser's `VisualViewport` dimensions, offsets, and pinch-zoom scale (useful for virtual keyboards).

items.name: useWakeLock
items.title: useWakeLock
items.description: Prevents the device screen from dimming or locking using the Screen Wake Lock API.

items.name: useWindowScroll
items.title: useWindowScroll
items.description: Tracks the window scroll position (`x`, `y`) and provides a `scrollTo` helper.

items.name: useWindowSize
items.title: useWindowSize
items.description: Tracks the browser window's `innerWidth` and `innerHeight` on resize.

items.name: all
items.title: All Hooks
items.description: Complete collection of all ohook React hooks and utilities.
